idea: Epic 23b row 23b.41: native SDKs match Dart in three regex corners older than S17. Dart's own quirk: inside (?i:A|B) a backreference in the first alternative compares case-sensitively ((?i:(.)\1|x) gu on Aa: Dart leaves it, both SDKs fold). With u, Swift refuses a class range whose two ends are escaped surrogate pairs, where Dart matches. With u, Swift reads a 4-digit high-half escape followed by a braced low-half escape as one letter, where Dart reads two halves. A fix is pattern-side, in each SDK's translator. In sdk-swift and sdk-kotlin
